picker_prompt: Who are you? Every verdict is saved under this name.
list_empty_mine: No batches for you: none in work, none available.
lock_mine: You hold this batch; nobody else can mark it. It finishes by itself on your last verdict.
lock_available: This batch is free. Take it to record verdicts; while you hold it, nobody else can mark it.
lock_locked: {name} holds this batch. You can only look for now.
lock_done: You finished this batch. You can still change your verdicts.
lock_closed: This batch is not for you: it has its reviews, or you may not take it. You can only look.
item_no_player: No player link for this item.
current_legacy_wrong_text: (legacy "Wrong text": re-decide with the track flag)
track_flag: Subtitle track ≠ video (text or timing off; whole video)
rules_who_paid_html: Sponsor — an outside party paid for this piece. Self-promotion — the speaker promotes themselves: subscribe, like, comment, own products, channels, events, client work. The test is who paid, not how long or how annoying it is.
rules_call_to_action_html: A call to action woven into the content ("write in the comments which…") is still self-promotion; say in the comment that you would not skip it. Whether to skip is decided by thresholds in code, not here.
rules_not_ad_html: Not an ad — the text is neither. Unclear — only when the text itself does not let you decide.
rules_track_html: Judge the verdict by the text. If the player shows something else at these times (other words, or the same words shifted), tick Subtitle track ≠ video as well; it marks the whole video, not this item.
signals_no_videos: no video rows for this native_id
signals_no_markups: No live markups in the window.
signals_no_segments: No calculated segments in the window.
hotkeys_html: Hotkeys: <kbd>1</kbd>–<kbd>{n}</kbd> verdict · <kbd>{flag}</kbd> track flag · <kbd>c</kbd> comment · <kbd>Enter</kbd> save (<kbd>Ctrl/Cmd+Enter</kbd> in the comment box) · <kbd>Esc</kbd> leave a text box · <kbd>j</kbd> / <kbd>k</kbd> next / previous · <kbd>o</kbd> open player
js_close_by_hand: Close the previous video tab by hand: the browser lets this page close only tabs it opened (start from the batch list).
js_read_only: You cannot record verdicts here right now: see the box at the top of the page.
js_force_confirm: {name} holds this batch. Release it? The verdicts of {name} stay.
conflict_done: You have already finished this batch.
conflict_closed: This batch is closed to you.
